sources.name: Caltrain GTFS-Realtime (via 511.org)
sources.auth: 511.org developer key, free, register at https://511.org/open-data/token
sources.fallback: caltrain.com static schedule + research if endpoints move
sources.notes: As of 2025+, Caltrain's own /files/rt/gtfsrt/*.pb endpoints return HTML; all live data is now via 511.org. Same protobuf shape.

sources.name: SFMTA Muni GTFS-Realtime (via 511.org)
sources.auth: 511.org developer key, free, register at https://511.org/open-data/token
sources.rate_limit: 60 requests / hour per token (shared with Caltrain)
sources.fallback: scrape NextBus / Muni site if 511 key unavailable

sources.name: Google Maps traffic ETA for short drive legs
sources.fallback: static default_minutes from legs.json if no key

511_org.note: 60 req/hour ⇒ at 60s poll across both agencies = 120 req/hr ⇒ exceeds limit. Real deployment: poll every 60s ONLY during active windows (AM 06:30-09:30, PM 17:00-20:30); poll every 5min outside. Per-agency: 60/2 = ~30 req/hr each at 2min cadence inside windows, well under limit.
